title: Fetching JSON
description:
The project has a file `users.json` (open it in the file list; the tests expect its original contents), which `fetch("users.json")` reads like a web API. Write:

```javascript
async function getJSON(url) { }      // the parsed JSON; throws Error(`${url}: HTTP ${status}`) when the response is not ok
async function activeByTeam(url) { } // { team: [names of active users, sorted] }, teams in first-seen order
function searchUrl(base, params) { } // base + "?" + the encoded params, leaving out null, undefined and "" values
```

`searchUrl("/search", { q: "tea & cake", page: 2, sort: null })` is `"/search?q=tea+%26+cake&page=2"`; with no params left, it is just the base.
hints: `fetch` fulfils even for a 404; `response.ok` is false and `response.status` holds the code.
The sample result includes `green: []`: create the team's list for every user, but push only the active ones.
